---
description: Generate 10 scroll-stopping hooks for a topic
---

Generate 10 scroll-stopping hooks for the topic given as input.

Rules:
- Vary the structure across the 10: include at least one question, one surprising stat, one contrarian take, one mini story opener, and one list promise.
- If brief/campaign-brief.md exists in this workspace, read it first and tune every hook to that audience, their pains, and their language. Otherwise write for a general professional audience.
- Each hook is 1-2 sentences, under 200 characters, and must work as the first line of a social post.
- No clickbait the topic cannot pay off. No hashtags, no emojis.
- Number them 1-10 and after each add a one-line note naming the platform it fits best (LinkedIn, X, or Instagram).

After the list, pick your top 2 and explain in one sentence each why they will stop the scroll.
